hypothesis: Replace unconditional publication of the final pretrained SMILES-policy epoch with heldout-constrained ancestral-support checkpoint selection: among the five otherwise unchanged epoch states, publish the checkpoint with the highest seeded unique-valid canonical sampling rate whose heldout token NLL remains within 0.02 nats per token of the Parent-equivalent terminal epoch.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: membership in a task-local beam-derived motif pool before oracle submission, with no scoring of the transient internal samples
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus language-model training plus task-local top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates from current oracle feedback
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: dynamic top-probability beam expansion for motif extraction followed by motif-gated rejection sampling of complete de novo SMILES
method_tags.representation: tokenized SMILES plus RDKit-extracted connected substructures from partial token trajectories

activation_observables.measurement: Preserve the complete five-epoch Parent training trajectory and retain each epoch state without changing optimization. After training, evaluate every checkpoint on the same fixed heldout token-NLL split and the same independently seeded 256-row ancestral sample panel. Treat the Parent-equivalent terminal epoch as the paired baseline, admit only checkpoints whose heldout token NLL is no more than 0.02 nats per token above that baseline, and select deterministically for maximum unique valid canonical rate. Report every checkpoint's completion, valid-canonical, unique-valid, and heldout-NLL values plus the selected-minus-terminal unique-valid-rate change for each seed and in aggregate; activation requires a nonterminal selected checkpoint and a positive unique-valid-rate change while satisfying the NLL constraint.

applicability_conditions: At least one nonterminal checkpoint must retain heldout sequence fit within 0.02 nats per token of the Parent-equivalent terminal epoch while producing a higher seeded unique-valid ancestral rate; otherwise the terminal Parent state is the bounded fallback and the mechanism does not activate.

The fixed 256-sample common-random-number panel must expose a reproducible support difference between checkpoints; the diagnostic may be uninformative when all checkpoints tie at the panel's finite resolution.

Checkpoint evaluation remains strictly task agnostic: it uses only the existing unlabeled-corpus holdout, generated SMILES validity, canonical identity, and the preparation seed, with no task name, oracle score, or online feedback.

A higher prior unique-valid rate is useful only if the selected support remains compatible with later reward adaptation, randomized-SMILES replay, beam parsing, and motif gating; this experiment does not claim that validity alone identifies high-reward chemistry.

The unchanged one-state-plus-JSON artifact must still instantiate identical frozen-prior and trainable-agent copies in every downstream session, and BOS, EOS, padding, vocabulary, architecture, and canonicalization semantics remain fixed.

This is a new offline checkpoint-selection mechanism, not a revisit of the Knowledge-only beam-motif cluster c-00bce518a8 or graph-equivalent randomized-SMILES cluster c-9956bd4a51; every online mechanism retained by n-a1feb7fbd3ae stays unchanged.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if the selector publishes the Parent-equivalent terminal epoch, if the selected checkpoint's seeded unique-valid canonical rate does not exceed the terminal checkpoint's rate, if its heldout NLL exceeds the terminal reference by more than 0.02 nats per token, or if the published state does not exactly match the recorded winning checkpoint. A positive support shift with unchanged or worse benchmark score would mean the mechanism activated without objective utility.
research_intent.implementation_change: Leave corpus sampling, tokenization, split, vocabulary, GRU architecture, teacher-forcing loss, optimizer, mixed precision, batch order, learning rate, dropout, and all five training epochs unchanged. Snapshot each epoch state without consuming RNG; only after the full Parent-identical trajectory, load each snapshot in evaluation mode, measure heldout token NLL, and draw the same independently seeded 256 ancestral samples. Keep checkpoints within 0.02 nats per token of the terminal epoch, choose the one with highest unique-valid canonical rate with valid rate, completion rate, lower NLL, and later epoch as deterministic tie breakers, reload that state, and publish the existing two-file artifact plus complete selection diagnostics. Leave every online generation, learning, replay, beam, motif, acquisition, and protocol path untouched.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace unconditional publication of the final pretrained SMILES-policy epoch with heldout-constrained ancestral-support checkpoint selection: among the five otherwise unchanged epoch states, publish the checkpoint with the highest seeded unique-valid canonical sampling rate whose heldout token NLL remains within 0.02 nats per token of the Parent-equivalent terminal epoch.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-a1feb7fbd3ae inherits the task-agnostic prior demonstrated by n-96c750192e04: its five-epoch corpus training lowers heldout autoregressive NLL from 4.304612920528885 to 0.664494836633308 and completes all 256 seeded ancestral samples, but only 222 are unique valid canonical molecules (rate 0.8671875). The source nevertheless publishes epoch five unconditionally, so 34 complete samples expose unusable prior mass even though an earlier near-equal-NLL checkpoint may have better chemical support. This matters before any online Layer acts and is consistent with the Parent's weakest three-seed means remaining median_2 at 0.21139955631803173 and sitagliptin_mpo at 0.2611605684579006; the limiting behavior addressed is last-epoch selection without a generative-support criterion, not replay, beam triggering, or motif gating.

applicability_conditions: The refutation applies to the evaluated 250,000-example unlabeled-corpus reservoir regime, fixed GRU architecture and optimizer, five-epoch schedule, three preparation seeds, 0.02-nat constraint, and one preparation-seeded 256-row common panel per checkpoint.

The selection mechanism can change publication only when an NLL-eligible nonterminal checkpoint exceeds the terminal checkpoint's unique-valid rate. That condition occurred on none of the three evaluated preparations; the bounded terminal fallback operated as specified in all three.

The closest admissible nonterminal comparison was seed 2 epoch 3 at 0.8515625 unique-valid rate and NLL 0.6965487603193047 versus terminal rates 0.86328125 and NLL 0.6927268561909409. Transfer claims for near ties remain limited by the fixed panel's finite resolution.

Checkpoint evaluation remained task agnostic in the observed implementation: preparation receives only corpus, artifact path, seed, and device, and its diagnostics contain no task identity, oracle score, or online feedback.

The unchanged artifact interface is supported under terminal fallback. Every Candidate emitted exactly smiles_prior.pt plus smiles_policy.json, its selected state was byte-identical to the corresponding Parent terminal state, and all fifteen downstream objective sessions completed normally.

This evidence determines only that no support-improving checkpoint was selected in these replicas. It does not establish whether a future nonterminal winner would improve reward-reachable chemistry or benchmark utility.

The closest admissible nonterminal comparison was seed 2 epoch 3 at 0.8515625 unique-valid rate and NLL 0.6965487603193047 versus terminal rates 0.86328125 and NLL 0.6927268561909409. Transfer claims for near ties remain limited by the fixed panel's finite resolution.

Checkpoint evaluation remained task agnostic in the observed implementation: preparation receives only corpus, artifact path, seed, and device, and its diagnostics contain no task identity, oracle score, or online feedback.

The unchanged artifact interface is supported under terminal fallback. Every Candidate emitted exactly smiles_prior.pt plus smiles_policy.json, its selected state was byte-identical to the corresponding Parent terminal state, and all fifteen downstream objective sessions completed normally.

This evidence determines only that no support-improving checkpoint was selected in these replicas. It does not establish whether a future nonterminal winner would improve reward-reachable chemistry or benchmark utility.

possible_failure_causes: The required opportunity was absent on the registered panels. Among NLL-eligible nonterminal checkpoints, seed 0's best was epoch 4 with 182 unique valid molecules versus 222 for terminal epoch 5, seed 1's best was epoch 4 with 206 versus 213, and seed 2's best was epoch 3 with 218 versus 221. The deterministic selector therefore correctly fell back to the terminal state on all three seeds.

The panel has finite 1/256 resolution. The closest terminal advantages were only 7 molecules on seed 1 and 3 on seed 2, so another independently seeded panel could reorder those near comparisons; the present evidence supports refutation under the pre-registered fixed panels, not a claim that a nonterminal checkpoint can never be better.

The 0.02-NLL constraint limited eligibility to epochs [4,5] on seed 0 and [3,4,5] on seeds 1 and 2. Earlier epochs were not selectable, although every excluded epoch also had lower measured unique-valid support than its terminal state in these replicas.

Valid-canonical and unique-valid rates were identical at every checkpoint in the logged panels, so the diagnostic observed no repeated valid canonical molecule within a seed-checkpoint panel. In this evidence, differences in the registered metric reflect canonical validity rather than an independently visible reduction in within-panel duplication.

Because every preparation published the exact Parent terminal state, the selector supplied no changed prior for downstream reward adaptation, randomized-SMILES replay, beam parsing, or motif gating. The identical downstream results are a consequence of terminal fallback and cannot test whether a genuinely different admissible checkpoint would remain compatible with those mechanisms.

activation_observables.measurement: Preserve the complete five-epoch Parent training trajectory and retain each epoch state without changing optimization. After training, evaluate every checkpoint on the same fixed heldout token-NLL split and the same independently seeded 256-row ancestral sample panel. Treat the Parent-equivalent terminal epoch as the paired baseline, admit only checkpoints whose heldout token NLL is no more than 0.02 nats per token above that baseline, and select deterministically for maximum unique valid canonical rate. Report every checkpoint's completion, valid-canonical, unique-valid, and heldout-NLL values plus the selected-minus-terminal unique-valid-rate change for each seed and in aggregate; activation requires a nonterminal selected checkpoint and a positive unique-valid-rate change while satisfying the NLL constraint.
activation_observables.name: prior_ancestral_valid_unique_rate

applicability_conditions: At least one nonterminal checkpoint must retain heldout sequence fit within 0.02 nats per token of the Parent-equivalent terminal epoch while producing a higher seeded unique-valid ancestral rate; otherwise the terminal Parent state is the bounded fallback and the mechanism does not activate.

The fixed 256-sample common-random-number panel must expose a reproducible support difference between checkpoints; the diagnostic may be uninformative when all checkpoints tie at the panel's finite resolution.

Checkpoint evaluation remains strictly task agnostic: it uses only the existing unlabeled-corpus holdout, generated SMILES validity, canonical identity, and the preparation seed, with no task name, oracle score, or online feedback.

A higher prior unique-valid rate is useful only if the selected support remains compatible with later reward adaptation, randomized-SMILES replay, beam parsing, and motif gating; this experiment does not claim that validity alone identifies high-reward chemistry.

The unchanged one-state-plus-JSON artifact must still instantiate identical frozen-prior and trainable-agent copies in every downstream session, and BOS, EOS, padding, vocabulary, architecture, and canonicalization semantics remain fixed.

This is a new offline checkpoint-selection mechanism, not a revisit of the Knowledge-only beam-motif cluster c-00bce518a8 or graph-equivalent randomized-SMILES cluster c-9956bd4a51; every online mechanism retained by n-a1feb7fbd3ae stays unchanged.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if the selector publishes the Parent-equivalent terminal epoch, if the selected checkpoint's seeded unique-valid canonical rate does not exceed the terminal checkpoint's rate, if its heldout NLL exceeds the terminal reference by more than 0.02 nats per token, or if the published state does not exactly match the recorded winning checkpoint. A positive support shift with unchanged or worse benchmark score would mean the mechanism activated without objective utility.

Snapshot each epoch state without consuming RNG; only after the full Parent-identical trajectory, load each snapshot in evaluation mode, measure heldout token NLL, and draw the same independently seeded 256 ancestral samples. Keep checkpoints within 0.02 nats per token of the terminal epoch, choose the one with highest unique-valid canonical rate with valid rate, completion rate, lower NLL, and later epoch as deterministic tie breakers, reload that state, and publish the existing two-file artifact plus complete selection diagnostics. Leave every online generation, learning, replay, beam, motif, acquisition, and protocol path untouched.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace unconditional publication of the final pretrained SMILES-policy epoch with heldout-constrained ancestral-support checkpoint selection: among the five otherwise unchanged epoch states, publish the checkpoint with the highest seeded unique-valid canonical sampling rate whose heldout token NLL remains within 0.02 nats per token of the Parent-equivalent terminal epoch.
